sn12.18:4.1: This uses the same construction as the previous discourse, but with feeling and the feeler, rather that the deed and the experiencer. Eternalism is not explicitly mentioned. But in the previous discourse, the phrase “for one who has existed since the beginning” is part of the eternalist view, and not the annihilationist, and the same is true here. See [mn2:8.8]() and note there.
